events.title: MTV Launched
events.blurb: Music Television (MTV) launched in 1981, with The Buggles' 'Video Killed The Radio Star' as its very first broadcast.

angles.name: Video Killed The Radio Star
angles.copy: Forty-five years ago today, MTV burst onto screens, forever changing the music landscape. And the first video ever played? The Buggles' iconic 'Video Killed The Radio Star'. The irony is still delicious.

events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe Anniversary
events.blurb: Oasis released their seminal debut album 'Definitely Maybe' in 1994.

angles.name: Definitely Maybe Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed British music forever. Still sounds as fresh and vital today. What's your favourite track?

events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Festival of Music & Art took place in 1969, attracting over 400,000 people.

angles.name: Woodstock Echoes
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm in upstate New York for three days of peace, love, and music. The spirit of Woodstock lives on.

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Elvis Presley, the King of Rock and Roll, passed away on this day in 1977. He would have been 91.

angles.name: Tribute to The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977. The King would have been 91 today, and his legacy continues to inspire generations.

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas in 1996. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac Legacy
angles.copy: Thirty years ago, the music world lost a giant. Remembering Tupac Shakur, who would have been 55 today, and whose powerful voice still resonates.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Jimi Hendrix, one of the greatest guitarists of all time, passed away on this day in 1970. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi Hendrix Tribute
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled genius of Jimi Hendrix, who left us on this day in 1970. He would have been 84, and his groundbreaking guitar work remains unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road Icon
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. That zebra crossing, those timeless tracks... pure musical magic.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, the formidable frontwoman of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking as hard as ever.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis and Beady Eye frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54 today! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Liam moment?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo single 'Imagine' in 1971.

angles.name: Imagine Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years ago, John Lennon gave the world 'Imagine'. A timeless message of peace and unity that still resonates today.

events.title: iPod Launch Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the first iPod in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Remembering the iPod
angles.copy: Twenty-five years ago, Apple dropped the original iPod and changed how we listen to music forever. Who remembers their first one?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the first Bond film premiere, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Sixty-four years since 'Dr. No' hit cinemas and launched the world's most famous secret agent. What's your favourite Bond film?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Legendary singer-songwriter John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we remember the iconic John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Iconic British comedian and actor John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the comedy legend, John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of mirth.

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', in 1968.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight. What's your favourite track?
